mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a mild 79 degrees with overcast skies, and you might spot the Waning Gibbous moon later tonight near the Military Ridge State Trail.

Two important updates for the city. First, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to fight food insecurity. Also, plan for road delays on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday as flagging crews work on utility connections.

There is a lot going on today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, the Girls Try Hockey event, and live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, on August 19, officers responded to a collision at North Main Street and Bering Drive where two drivers were cited for various traffic violations.
It is a perfect time to stop by for today's flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
